text:
Excellent Sunday match was played by our U14 (Havířov Ostrava Bears) in Petrovice. The first half showed us a lot to work on, but the second half was really worth it 💚💛.
We don't sleep, we keep working. Slávia awaits us at home on Sunday.
Let’s Go Bears 💛🐻🐻💚
